lines.speaker: board_secretary
lines.text: The Board is not in session. You may stand there. You may not sit.

lines.speaker: board_secretary
lines.text: Four seats. Three are held by instruments rather than persons: a trust, a fund and a holding company. The fourth has been occupied continuously since 2091.

lines.speaker: board_secretary
lines.text: By the founding chair. He uploaded in 2091 and the seat has never been vacated, because a seat is vacated by death and the instrument does not define one.

lines.speaker: board_secretary
lines.text: The Steward allocates. The Board owns. The Steward has never been asked to allocate anything to the Board and would not know how, which is the whole design.

lines.speaker: board_secretary
lines.text: Your own name is in the register on that table, on the first page, dated 2031. The Board has not raised it. I would not assume that means it has not noticed.

lines.speaker: board_secretary
lines.text: There is enforcement in the antechamber this quarter for the first time in my service. Something told it that its history was being edited.
